_note: Find Your Animal cards, in display order. Every card links to /product. image is the asset name in assets/manifest.json (find-your-animal); the partial reads its outputs from there. surface is a data-surface value from css/tokens.css: sand, warm-sand (this section only, never terracotta on it), dark, dark-olive. Swapping an animal means editing this file and the art only.
heading: Find your animal

cards.name: The Cat
cards.title: For slow mornings and quiet evenings
cards.body: Music on low while the coffee brews. A book, a slow Sunday, the last hour before bed. You are not filling the room, you are softening it.
cards.support: Holds its detail at low volume. A coaxial driver and a proper crossover keep music clear when it is barely on.

cards.name: The Weaver Bird
cards.title: For people who are always making something
cards.body: The desk, the workbench, the studio table. Hands busy, music on for hours, and never anywhere near your phone to change it.
cards.support: Nothing on the desk. Nothing to knock over. Nothing to charge.

cards.name: The Elephant
cards.title: For the house where everyone gathers
cards.body: Sunday lunch. Cousins arriving. Three generations in one room and nobody sitting still.
cards.support: Sound from above fills a room evenly, instead of pointing at whoever got the good seat.

cards.name: The Zebra
cards.title: For the host
cards.body: Dinner that turns into drinks. People standing, moving, talking over each other, and the music holding it together.
cards.support: Six to ten feet apart gives you real stereo across the whole room. Nobody ends up shouting next to a speaker.
